import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Income Distribution by Education
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
education_order = ['PhD', 'Graduation', 'Master', '2n Cycle', 'Basic']
education_order = [e for e in education_order if e in df['Education'].unique()]
sns.boxplot(data=df, y='Education', x='Income', order=education_order, ax=ax1, palette='Set2')
ax1.set_title('Income Distribution by Education', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Income', fontsize=9)
ax1.set_ylabel('Education', fontsize=9)

# 2. Total Spending by Product Category
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_totals = df[spending_cols].sum()
spending_totals.index = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(spending_totals))
ax2.bar(range(len(spending_totals)), spending_totals.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(spending_totals)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(spending_totals.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax2.set_title('Total Spending by Product Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Amount Spent', fontsize=9)

# 3. Age Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']
ax3.hist(df['Age'], bins=20, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=9)
ax3.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=9)

# 4. Marital Status Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('pastel', len(marital_counts))
ax4.pie(marital_counts.values, labels=marital_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Marital Status Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Purchase Channels Comparison
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
purchase_totals = df[purchase_cols].sum()
purchase_totals.index = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store']
colors = sns.color_palette('muted', len(purchase_totals))
ax5.bar(range(len(purchase_totals)), purchase_totals.values, color=colors)
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(purchase_totals)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(purchase_totals.index)
ax5.set_title('Total Purchases by Channel', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Purchases', fontsize=9)

# 6. Income vs Total Spending Scatter
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['TotalSpending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)
scatter = ax6.scatter(df['Income'], df['TotalSpending'], alpha=0.6, c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', s=50)
ax6.set_title('Income vs Total Spending', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Income', fontsize=9)
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=9)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax6)
cbar.set_label('Age', fontsize=8)

# 7. Number of Children Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
df['TotalChildren'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
children_counts = df['TotalChildren'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax7.bar(children_counts.index, children_counts.values, color='coral', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_title('Distribution of Children at Home', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Number of Children', fontsize=9)
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)

# 8. Campaign Acceptance Rates
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
campaign_acceptance = df[campaign_cols].sum()
campaign_acceptance.index = ['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5', 'Last Cmp']
colors = sns.color_palette('Set3', len(campaign_acceptance))
ax8.bar(range(len(campaign_acceptance)), campaign_acceptance.values, color=colors, edgecolor='black')
ax8.set_xticks(range(len(campaign_acceptance)))
ax8.set_xticklabels(campaign_acceptance.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax8.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Number of Acceptances', fontsize=9)

# 9. Recency Distribution
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.hist(df['Recency'], bins=20, color='lightgreen', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax9.set_title('Customer Recency Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_xlabel('Days Since Last Purchase', fontsize=9)
ax9.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=9)

plt.suptitle('Customer Marketing Data Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
